summary: Active assignments behaves better on large tenants, and alert mails are short and clear.

fixes.title: Active assignments says what is happening
fixes.text: On a large tenant, a stored list that cannot be loaded now says so instead of starting a new read. Repeat loads are faster.

fixes.title: Alert mails in one short table
fixes.text: Alert mails show who acts, the status, the problem, what to do, the findings one per line, and where to get support.
